questions.question: During a war, the prophet Elisha sent the king of Israel a warning about where Aram planned to camp. What did it say?

answers.text: Be careful not to pass by that place
Set up your own camp there first
Attack that place before they arrive

questions.question: When an Aramean army surrounded the city where Elisha stayed, what reason did Elisha give his servant for not being afraid?

answers.text: There are more with us than with them
The army will leave before night
The city walls are too strong for them

questions.question: When the Aramean army came down to capture Elisha, what did Elisha ask the LORD to do to them?

answers.text: Put them into a deep sleep

questions.question: Elisha told the king of Israel not to kill the captured Aramean soldiers. What did he say to do instead?

answers.text: Set food and water before them
Lock them up in the city prison
Make them work on the city walls
